events.body:
Source: Forkmesh QA Bug Report FM-QA-2026-08-02 (BUG-02; supporting screenshot Fig. 2)
Severity: Critical
Area: Scroll Rendering
Environment: Web (desktop and mobile)

## Summary
Sections intermittently fail to render while scrolling between the top and bottom of the site. A black screen is shown before the content appears after a noticeable delay.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Load the Forkmesh homepage and allow it to finish rendering.
2. Scroll quickly from the top of the page to the bottom.
3. Scroll back from the bottom to the top.
4. Observe sections as they enter the viewport in each direction.

## Expected
Every section renders smoothly and immediately when it enters the viewport, in either scroll direction, without blank or black frames.

## Actual
Content intermittently fails to render during scrolling. The viewport becomes black and content pops in only after a delay.

## Investigation notes
Review viewport-based lazy mounting, virtualization, and IntersectionObserver behavior. Canvas or content may be unmounted, or its render loop paused, without a reliable repaint on re-entry. Preserve a placeholder and pre-render buffer rather than exposing an empty frame.
events.title: Black screen or missing content while scrolling
